nodes.label: Application component REQUIRES (console, WiFi, lwIP, NVS)
nodes.rationale: main.c uses esp_console (REPL over USB-Serial-JTAG) so `console` is required; net_link.c uses WiFi STA + UDP (esp_wifi/esp_netif/esp_event/lwip) plus nvs_flash because esp_wifi needs NVS to persist RF calibration. Neither of these pulls the other in transitively, so both must be listed explicitly.
